message.content:
An editorial illustration depicts three vertical sections. The top section shows a gray house silhouette containing the word “TEMPO” in large red letters. A man and woman stand on a white cloudy ground before the house. The woman wears a green dress, and the man wears a light jacket. Above, white text reads: “Maju-Mundur RUU Perlindungan Pekerja Rumah Tangga H.24” and “Gubernur Bank Sentral Dua Periode H.76”.

The middle section has a dark horizontal band with white text: “HARTA KARUN PEJABAT PAJAK”. Below, white text reads: “Pegawai Pajak Rafael Alun Trisambodo dicurigai menyembunyikan kekayaan tak wajar berupa aset properti selain kendaraan mewah. Benarkah dia memimpin komplotan pengatur pajak? H.56”. This section features a red background containing a gray car under a cover, a black motorcycle, and a black off-road vehicle. A vertical ladder connects this level to the bottom section.

The bottom section shows a gray metallic vault door with a circular locking mechanism and a ladder. Small white text at the bottom provides dates, price, and publication details. A barcode and QR code are in the lower right.
